events.title: FDA批准Daiichi Sankyo和AstraZeneca的Enhertu ？
events.description:
As of market creation, the FDA's expected decision date for the specified application is May 18, 2026.

This market will resolve to "Yes" if the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) grants full or conditional approval for Daiichi Sankyo & AstraZeneca's Enhertu as a treatment for neoadjuvant treatment of adult patients with HER2-positive breast cancer by June 1, 2026, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No."

An approval is defined as:
For new drugs: FDA issuance of an approval letter for a New Drug Application (NDA) or Biologics License Application (BLA)
For already-marketed drugs seeking new indications: FDA approval of a supplemental NDA (sNDA) or supplemental BLA (sBLA) for the specific indication referenced
For generic drugs: FDA approval of an Abbreviated New Drug Application (ANDA)
For biosimilars: FDA approval of a 351(k) application

The following constitute qualifying approvals:
Standard approval (traditional approval based on clinical benefit), Accelerated approval (based on surrogate endpoints), Approval with Risk Evaluation and Mitigation Strategy (REMS), Approval with restricted distribution or indication limitations, except compassionate use/expanded access programs

The following do not constitute qualifying approvals:
Approvable letters that require additional actions before approval
Tentative approvals pending patent or exclusivity expiration
FDA requests for additional information or studies
Extension of Prescription Drug User Fee Amendments dates
Approval for compassionate use or expanded access programs only
Approval only for export or for use outside the United States
Emergency Use Authorization (EUA) without full approval
Complete Response Letters (CRLs) indicating the application cannot be approved in its current form

This market will immediately resolve to "No" if the FDA issues a Complete Response Letter (CRL) or explicitly declines to approve the application. If the drug sponsor withdraws the application before the end of the specified period, the market will resolve to "No" immediately.

If the listed drug is approved before the end of the specified period, the market will resolve to "Yes," regardless of potential Advisory Committee votes against approval or later withdrawal of approval.

Conditional approvals may include post-marketing requirements or commitments and still qualify.

The primary resolution source will be official information from the FDA; however, a consensus of credible reporting will also be used.

events.description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if Google's Gemini 3.2 model is made available to the general public by the specified date (ET). Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No."

Gemini 3.2 refers to a product explicitly named Gemini 3.2, or a variant that is recognized as a direct successor to Gemini 3.1, similar to the progression from Gemini 3 to Gemini 3.1. (e.g., Gemini 3.2 GA, Gemini 3.2/3.3/3.4, etc., in any variant, like Pro/Deep Think/Flash/Flash-lite, would qualify toward a "Yes" resolution to this market).

Specialized models for non-text modalities such as video generation (e.g., Veo), image generation (e.g., Imagen, Nano Banana), music generation (e.g., Lyria), or robotics (e.g., Gemini Robotics) will NOT qualify, even if released under the Gemini 3.2 version number. Products labeled as a GA promotion of an already-existing Preview model (e.g., Gemini 3.1 GA) or a new flagship generation (e.g., Gemini 4) or similar that are not explicitly labeled as described above will NOT qualify.

A qualifying model must be launched and publicly accessible, including via open beta or open rolling waitlist signups. A closed beta or any form of private access will not suffice. The release must be either clearly defined and publicly announced by Google as being accessible to the general public or otherwise made publicly accessible and explicitly labeled within the company's official website. Labeling errors, placeholder text, or version names displayed on the website that do not correspond to a model that is actually accessible to the general public will not qualify.

The primary resolution source for this market will be official information from Google, with additional verification from a consensus of credible reporting.

NZ Election: Popular Vote Margin of Victory?
events.description:
A general election is scheduled to be held in New Zealand on November 7, 2026. New Zealand uses a mixed-member proportional electoral system in which most voters cast two votes: one for a candidate in a single-member electorate and one party vote for a political party list.

This market will resolve according to the margin of victory between the top two parties in terms of party list votes in this election.

The “margin of victory” is defined as the absolute difference between the percentages of valid party list votes received by the party that wins the most party list votes and the party that wins the second-most party list votes. Percentages of valid party list votes received by each party will be determined by dividing the total number of valid party list votes each of the top two parties receives by the sum of all valid party list votes cast in the election. This market includes party list votes cast by both the general electorate and the Maori electorate.

This market will resolve solely based on party list votes cast in this election. Electorate votes will not be considered.

If two or more parties tie for the most valid party list votes in this election, this market will resolve to the lowest margin bracket for the party whose listed name comes first in alphabetical order.

If the results of this election are not definitively known by October 31, 2027, 11:59 PM ET, this market will resolve to “Other”.

This market will resolve based on the official election results reported by the New Zealand Electoral Commission (https://elections.nz/). However, an overwhelming consensus of credible reporting may also suffice.

events.description:
The FED interest rates are defined in this market by the upper bound of the target federal funds rate. The decisions on the target federal funds rate are made by the Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC) meetings.

This market will resolve according to the decisions made by the next three Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC) meetings: June 16-17; July 28-29; and September 15-16.

A qualifying cut occurs when the new upper bound of the target federal funds rate is lower compared to the level it was prior to the respective meeting.

A qualifying hike occurs when the new upper bound of the target federal funds rate is higher compared to the level it was prior to the respective meeting.

A qualifying pause occurs when the new upper bound of the target federal funds rate is equal to the level it was prior to the respective meeting.

If the Fed publishes a different combination than any listed, this market will resolve to "Other". Any rate hike will be encompassed by "Other".

Emergency rate cuts outside the regularly scheduled meetings will not be considered.

The resolution source for this market is the FOMC’s statement after its meetings:
https://www.federalreserve.gov/monetarypolicy/fomccalendars.htm

The level and change of the target federal funds rate is also published at the official website of the Federal Reserve:
https://www.federalreserve.gov/monetarypolicy/openmarket.htm

q5.aGeneric: 活动不断变化，但您可以按 24 小时交易量对页面进行排序，以实时查看交易集中在哪里。

q6.q: {categoryLabel} 预测市场是如何解决的？
q6.a: 每个 {categoryLabel} 市场都有明确定义的解决方案来源和标准，发布在市场页面上。当事件结束时，例如，当结果被正式报告、截止日期过去或权威消息来源确认结果时，市场就会解决，获胜的股票每股将获得 1 美元。选举、经济和地缘政治等类别的市场通常依赖官方政府、监管或主要来源报告来解决。

q7.q: 为什么 {categoryLabel} 赔率变化如此频繁？
q7.aSpecific: {categoryLabel} 市场实时响应新闻、公告、数据发布和政策变化。单一的事态发展，例如新的民意调查、经济指标、法院裁决或地缘政治事件，都可以极大地改变结果的隐含概率。纵观 {featuredMarket1} 这样的市场，价格变动反映出交易者在新信息到来时不断更新他们的观点。
q7.aGeneric: {categoryLabel} 市场实时响应新闻、公告、数据发布和政策变化。单一的事态发展，例如新的民意调查、经济指标、法院裁决或地缘政治事件，都可以极大地改变结果的隐含概率。

q10.q: Polymarket 的 {categoryLabel} 赔率比民意调查或预测更准确吗？
q10.a: 预测市场和传统预测（例如民意调查、模型或分析师估计）是互补的工具。由于 Polymarket 交易者冒着真实资本的风险，{categoryLabel} 赔率将许多参与者的信息和激励汇总成一个概率，这种机制历来密切跟踪选举、经济和地缘政治等领域的现实世界结果。也就是说，没有市场是万能的。赔率代表交易者在某个时间点的共识，而不是对将要发生的情况的预测。

general.q1: Polymarket 上的电竞交易是什么？
general.a1: Polymarket 让你可以就 CS2、英雄联盟、Dota 2、无畏契约等职业电竞比赛的赛果进行交易。买入你认为会获胜的队伍的份额——若该队获胜，每份份额按 $1 兑付。
general.a2: Polymarket 涵盖主要竞技项目，包括 Counter-Strike 2、英雄联盟、Dota 2、无畏契约、使命召唤、守望先锋、无尽对决、彩虹六号：围攻、火箭联盟、王者荣耀、星际争霸 II 等。
general.a3: 每场比赛都有胜负盘（moneyline）市场，可购买任一方的份额。价格反映社区对各队获胜概率的估计。
general.a4: 可以。当有直播时，记分牌上会显示「观看直播」按钮，点击后会打开可拖动、可调整大小的悬浮播放器。
general.a5: 市场根据赛事主办方的官方赛果结算。获胜份额兑付 $1，落败份额归零。
general.a6: Polymarket 是全球最大的预测市场平台，可用真实资金对现实世界事件的结果进行交易。

league.a2: 每场 {league} 比赛通常有胜负盘市场供你选择获胜方。视赛制不同，还可能看到地图让分、地图总数、单图胜者等市场。

resolution.a: "{title}"市场根据 {leagueName} 官方结果报告的正式最终比分进行结算，包括加时赛（如适用）。Moneyline 市场结算为赢得比赛的球队。Spreads 市场根据最终胜利差距与发布的盘口进行结算。Totals（大/小）市场根据两队的最终总分进行结算。Player Props 市场根据官方技术统计进行结算。如果比赛被推迟或取消，市场结算规则（可在本页规则部分查看）将说明如何处理该情况。我们建议在交易前审阅完整的结算标准。

about.title: 关于2026年美国中期选举
about.schemaDescription: 了解2026年美国中期选举，包括参议院、众议院和州长选举。
about.p1: 2026年美国中期选举定于2026年11月3日举行，将决定第120届美国国会的组成以及广泛的州和地方职位。全部435个众议院席位、100个参议院席位中的35个、美国各州36个州长职位以及全国各地众多州议会、行政和地方竞选都将出现在选票上。这是自1894年以来首次在非连续总统第二任期内举行的全国性中期选举，Donald Trump 总统在 Republicans 于2024年总统大选中横扫总统职位、参议院和众议院后重返白宫，建立了自2017年以来未曾出现的联邦政府统一执政。
about.p2: 历史上，总统所在政党往往在中期选举中失去众议院席位，这一规律可能重塑华盛顿的权力平衡。选举预测模型已经在将这一基本趋势与 Donald Trump 总统的支持率和通用选票等早期指标进行权衡。政治学家和民调机构长期研究控制白宫的政党在这些选举中的表现。预计将主导2026年选举周期的关键议题包括政府开支削减、移民执法、关税和贸易政策以及福利项目的未来。参议院版图有利于 Republicans，众议院则有数十个郊区摇摆地区的竞争性竞选，2026年中期选举有望成为近年来最具影响力的选举之一。Polymarket 的预测市场为每场重要竞选提供实时众包赔率，让用户在选举日前获得政治格局的无偏见视角。
about.p3: 在参议院，Democrats 面临结构性困难的版图。在参加选举的35个席位中，Democrats 需要防守23个，而 Republicans 防守10个，另外还有 Florida 和 Ohio 的两场特别选举，以填补 Marco Rubio 出任国务卿和 JD Vance 出任副总统后空出的席位。Republicans 目前拥有53对47的多数优势，而民主党席位集中在 Trump 总统2024年赢得的州，这赋予了 GOP 在保护多数优势方面的结构性优势。独立选民往往在这些竞争性竞选中发挥决定性作用。Maine 仍然是唯一一个由 Republicans 持有、但该州被 Kamala Harris 赢得的参议院席位，使其成为 Democrats 的首要目标。Democrats 还在关注 Georgia 和 Michigan 的席位——两个被 Trump 赢得但全州参议院竞选近几个周期保持接近的州。Polymarket 交易者反映了 GOP 在参议院控制权市场中的防守优势。
about.p4: 众议院选举同样至关重要。Republicans 在美国众议院以220对215的微弱多数执政，这一差距足够小，只需在竞争性众议院竞选中净失几个席位就会将众议院控制权移交给 Democrats。众议院预测模型和民调机构追踪通用选票上仅几个百分点的变化如何可能导致 Democrats 在该院获胜。本周期的众议院版图包含数个新划定的国会选区，Ohio 和 Utah 实施法院命令的地图，Missouri、North Carolina 和 Texas 完成了周期中重新划分。批评者将一些周期中地图变更定性为不公正划分选区（gerrymandering），即以有利于一个政党的方式划定选区界线，这些重新划分在几个州引发了法律审查。根据选区层面的分析，16名 Democrats 现任议员目前在 Trump 2024年赢得的选区任职，而8名 Republicans 现任议员持有 Harris 赢得的席位，形成了两党阵营中一批真正的摇摆众议院竞选，随着选举日临近将吸引大量资金和关注。
about.p5: New York 和 Pennsylvania 等州的高关注度州长竞选预计将产生资金充裕的竞争性竞选，对能源、教育、医疗和刑事司法政策具有重大影响。许多现任州长正在寻求连任，2026年当选的州长还将在2030年重新划分选区周期之前塑造各州的政治基础设施。
about.p6: 截至2026年3月，2026年联邦选举周期已经活跃起来，多个州的初选正在进行中，更多初选计划在夏季和秋季举行。这些早期竞赛让选民和交易者首次清晰看到竞争性竞选中的候选人素质。
about.p7: 众议院于2026年2月通过了 SAVE America Act，如果该法案通过参议院并经总统签署成为法律，将要求联邦选举选民登记时提供美国公民身份的文件证明。参议院现已开始就该措施进行辩论。支持者称其为选举诚信的直接保障；反对者则认为它可能减少某些合格选民的投票渠道。Donald Trump 总统已公开将该法案与11月前加强投票规则的更广泛努力联系起来。
about.p8: 关于周期中国会选区重新划分的单独辩论在几个州继续进行，一些新划定的地图面临持续的法律挑战和不公正划分选区的指控。这些程序性问题——加上总统所在政党在中期选举中的历史性脆弱性——正在影响选举预测模型和 Polymarket 对议院控制权及个别竞选的定价。
about.p9: Democrats 可能利用这些动态争取席位增长。总体而言，2026年中期选举代表了数十年来最具流动性的非总统选举周期之一。两院控制权都真正悬而未决，独立选民预计将在摇摆选区和州发挥超大作用，Polymarket 的实时预测市场提供了对每场重要竞选交易者共识的最清晰众包视角。即将到来的初选、立法投票以及国家环境的任何变化将继续实时推动概率变化。
